raw_text: BSF shoots down third Pakistani drone in a week on Punjab border. This one carrying 5kg heroin near Amritsar. The narco-terror nexus from Kasur district in Pakistan continues to use cheap hexacopters for cross-border drug deliveries. India deploying anti-drone systems but the 553km Punjab border is hard to cover completely. This is a persistent asymmetric threat.
